_doc: Human confirmations of identity links that could not be established by phone match.
This file exists so that resolving an ambiguity is a DATA change, not a code edit,
and so that every resolved identity carries a record of who resolved it and when.
- An attestation may link a WhatsApp speaker_id to an intake-form row and/or a LinkedIn URL.
- It must name the attester and the date. 'Someone said so' is not an attestation.
- An attestation NEVER merges two speaker_ids. If two people might be the same person,
that stays unresolved until someone attests to it explicitly.
- Removing an attestation must cleanly remove the data it authorised. Never bake it in.
